NC(1)                   General Commands Manual                  NC(1)

NAME
     nc - fake netcat page for tests

OPTIONS
     -l	Listen for an incoming connection rather than initiating
	 a connection to a remote host.

     -p source_port
	 Use source_port as the source port.

     -u	Use UDP instead of TCP.

     -v	Be verbose.

     -q[:stream] seconds (input,output)
	 Quit after seconds.

     -z	Scan for listening daemons without sending data.

EXAMPLES
     Open a UDP connection to port 53 of host.example.org:

           $ nc -u host.example.org 53

     Wait for a connection on port 4567 and say what happens:
           $ nc -l -p 4567 \
                 -v
